explanation: Mostly high (about 9-10 at D1 and D2, 8-9 at GO) during steady runs of rewarded trials, especially early in the episode (trials ~10-30) while the agent keeps choosing a2. It dips mainly at GO after an unrewarded trial (about 6-7 after one loss, 0-3 after two or more losses in a row; lower still late in the episode, trials 75+), and after runs of losses D1 drops to 3-6 and D2 to 5-7.
